newsitem.title: INDIA: Larsen & Toubro lifts Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Larsen & Toubro lifts Delhi shares.

text.p: Strong buying in engineering conglomerate Larsen and Toubro pushed Delhi stock prices higher in the afternoon trade on Monday, brokers said.
At 12.30 p.m. (0700 GMT) the Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index was up 23.20 points, or 2.5 percent, to 935.18.
Larsen and Toubro rose 13.20 rupees to 283.50. Traders said buying was fuelled by encouraging working results in the first quarter of 1997/98 (April-March).
The company said on Friday its sales rose 23 percent to 12.69 billion rupees in the first quarter of 1997/98 from 10.32 billion a year ago.

"Expectations that the Unit Trust of India (UTI), country's largest mutual fund, would invest in the secondary market led to a sharp upsurge in prices," Suresh Aggarwal of stock brokerage firm Jai Mata Securities said.
Reliance Industries Ltd gained 6.00 rupees to 366.40.
State Bank of India rose 16.00 rupees to 335.25.
Hindustan Lever Ltd climbed 19.10 rupees to 1,489.00.
